items.title: Tyler Technologies (TYL) Just Completed Tennessee’s Largest Statewide Tax Cloud Rollout

The project was carried out for the Tennessee Comptroller of the Treasury and now supports hundreds of property assessment users across the state. Tyler Technologies (NYSE:TYL) focuses on software and services for the public sector, and this Tennessee rollout is in that core business.
